title: US2 post-merge review fixes are verified; protected closure remains
summary: PR #69 is a draft branch from main. The public API now uses the standard wide generative poster variant and preserves contributor database failures as server errors. The reader is role-aware, final-block progress-safe, hydration-safe, localStorage-safe and independently tracks multiple generative canvases. Exact-head CI, Security and 11/11 browser tests pass. Protected merge, production activation and task state remain human gates.

claims.text: PR #69 is a draft branch from main@d86d59eade447ad79f927079735d1efa48ebad38 and no merge or task checkbox change was performed.
Generative-canvas public poster resolution requests the standard wide media variant; the browser fixture and proof assert the wide URL rather than a non-standard poster variant.
Contributor database failures propagate as DataAccessException; only expected IllegalArgumentException projection validation is handled as an empty contributor projection.
Reader credits preserve contributor roles and JSON-LD author contains AUTHOR contributors only.
At document end, progress selects the final data-block-id before visible-block scanning and the browser proof stores the final fixture block.
Creative opt-in is hidden until clientReady, multiple generative canvases have per-block visibility/runtime state, and localStorage exceptions disable persistence without breaking the page.
Implementation head 86cba75a48b15469358ec62e88ff032fbad6e2d6 passed CI run 31322183085, Security run 31322183089 and browser job 93266881906 with 11/11 tests passing.
Protected merge, production migration execution/activation and task checkbox updates were intentionally not performed.
